id: title:Gilbert09:retry object store timeouts writing parquet batches

review.posthog_relevance: Adds transient error classification and retry suppression for S3 batch writes, potentially reducing unnecessary retries for certificate or connection failures.
review.reason: Adds botocore exception handling and distinguishes SSLError, HTTPClientError, and OSError. P1.F2.H2 checks if an S3 write error is transient and retryable before batch failure, excluding SSLError from retry. This could prevent unnecessary retries for certificate errors while allowing recovery from transient network blips.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the actual runtime behavior of the classified exceptions and the specific transient nature of the errors encountered; no test or production outcome is supplied.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds botocore.exceptions import and checks for SSLError, HTTPClientError, ConnectionError, OSError, and botocore exceptions.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks if an S3 write error is transient and retryable before the batch fails; distinguishes botocore exceptions from OSError and excludes SSLError from retry. This could prevent unnecessary retries for certificate errors while allowing recovery from transient network blips.
